services.name: Private Motor Yacht Charter
services.desc: About Our 36' Motor Yacht is actually a Catamaran with a beautiful fly bridge, perfect for taking in all of Lake Tahoe's wonder and beauty. Complete with all the luxury you would expect on any yacht, the "Tahoe Dreamer" accommodates up to 12 passengers and always includes beverages such as premium beer, wine, prosecco and non-alcoholic drinks. Trip start times are adjustable depending on availability. Please call our office for customized trips. faq.a: Advance purchase is strongly recommended, as cruises tend to sell out well in advance. To maximize your chances of getting the day and time you prefer, please book well in advance. Tickets can be purchased with a Visa, Mastercard or American Express. When does your season run? We operate daily beginning in mid May, and our season runs through mid Oct.
